latest_release.body:
## What's new

- Your chat input is calm again. I removed the `cache may have expired` strip that kept nagging you after every restart and model switch. Compacting early never actually saved you anything there, so I now quietly trim old tool output on my own and leave your input alone.
- Skills from your other coding agents now just work. I read the shared `.agents/skills` folders that Codex, Amp and friends use, and a skill marked manual-only stays put until you ask for it by name. Your own `.gg/skills` still win if two share a name.
- My built-in safety skills got a fresh brain for December. They know the newest privacy and AI rules landing in the next few weeks, the new `OWASP 2026` AI security list and `Postgres 19`, so the guardrails I build into your app match today, not last month.

Download the installer for your platform from the assets below.

detail.readme:
Cause the other agents piss me off.

English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español | Português | Deutsch | Français

GG Coder is a desktop coding agent that gets more out of the AI subscription you already pay for. > [!TIP] > **Want the step-by-step guide?** > - **Raid+:** land your first paying client in 90 days or your money back, plus private tools you won't find anywhere else: [skool.com/kenkai](https://www.skool.com/kenkai) > - **Want it built for you?** [work.kenkais.com](https://work.kenkais.com/) > ⭐ **If GG Coder saves you time or money, give it a star.** It's the main way other developers find it. ## Why GG Coder - **More work per plan.** Fastest and leanest of 20 agents I raced on the same model. Claude Code used 169% more for the same work. - **Real code, not guesses.** Agent Steroids searches real, current open-source code on your machine. No rate-limited MCP server, no limits. - **Done means checked.** Ken Autopilot keeps the work going until it's actually verified. - **Ship it properly, even as a beginner.** Coding is only part of it. One-click checks for security, compliance, data safety, accessibility, tests and more, plus a Project health score, so you don't need to know what to ask for. - **Your subscriptions.** Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi Code, MiniMax and MiMo plans, any API key, or local models. | Agent | Time for the full suite | Usage per suite | Time vs GG Coder | Usage vs GG Coder | | ------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------- | ---------------- | ----------------- | | **GG Coder** | **102 s** | **$0.014** | | | | Codewhale | 112 s | $0.022 | 10% slower | 58% more | | Goose | 132 s | $0.020 | 29% slower | 46% more | | GitHub Copilot CLI | 136 s | $0.025 | 33% slower | 83% more | | Kimi Code | 138 s | $0.024 | 36% slower | 74% more | | Claude Code | 142 s | $0.037 | 39% slower | 169% more | | ForgeCode | 155 s | $0.042 | 52% slower | 204% more | | Dirac | 160 s | $0.029 | 57% slower | 114% more | | Crush | 165 s | $0.037 | 62% slower | 173% more | | Factory Droid | 167 s | $0.025 | 64% slower | 83% more | | Mistral Vibe | 169 s | $0.036 | 66% slower | 164% more | | DeepSeek-Reasonix | 170 s | $0.027 | 67% slower | 99% more | | Oh My Pi | 170 s | $0.031 | 67% slower | 123% more | | Xum | 172 s | $0.041 | 69% slower | 203% more | | Docker Agent | 173 s | $0.021 | 70% slower | 51% more | | Qwen Code | 177 s | $0.049 | 74% slower | 257% more | | Prime Agent | 190 s | $0.029 | 86% slower | 111% more | | Hermes Agent | 190 s | $0.027 | 87% slower | 100% more | | Deep Agents | 201 s | $0.041 | 97% slower | 198% more | | jcode | 380 s | $0.178 | 274% slower | 1196% more | Table: one full race on 4 November 2026. 20 agents, each on a current stable release (GG Coder v0.102.0), 7 tasks, 5 runs each (700 runs), all on Claude Haiku 5.5 with the same thinking setting. Every agent got the same prompts and a fresh copy of the project each run, and ran bare, GG Coder included: its own built-in prompt and tools, with no skills, plugins, MCP servers or custom instructions. The tasks use small test projects plus one question about Vite's codebase (v8.3.5), so no agent works on its own code. A run counts only if hidden tests pass or the answer is correct. ## Also included - **GG Goals:** hand over a whole goal; a team of workers sees it through. - **Chat:** conversations that remember context. - **GG Motion:** turns your ideas into videos. ## Get started 1. Install GG Coder: **macOS (Apple Silicon):** [Download the latest release](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest) and open the `.dmg`. **Windows:** [Download the latest release](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest) and run the `.exe` installer. **Linux (x86_64):** [Download the latest release](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest) and install the `.deb` (`sudo apt install ./GG*.deb`) or `.rpm` (`sudo dnf install ./GG*.rpm`). **Development:** With Node.js, pnpm, and the [Tauri prerequisites](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/) installed: ```bash git clone https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework.git cd gg-framework pnpm install pnpm build pnpm --filter gg-app tauri dev ``` 2. Open the app, connect your AI provider, and pick Code, Chat, or Motion. ## Build with the framework Want the engine without the desktop app? Use the same packages in your own apps. Install just what you need. - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-ai**](packages/gg-ai/README.md): Connect to AI providers and stream responses. - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-agent**](packages/gg-agent/README.md): Build agents that use your tools and work through tasks. - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-core**](packages/gg-core/README.md): Model selection, authentication, and local model discovery. - [**@kenkaiiii/ggcoder**](packages/ggcoder/README.md): The coding agent, sessions, and tools behind the app and CLI. For your own agent, start here: ```bash npm install @kenkaiiii/gg-ai @kenkaiiii/gg-agent ``` The package links above cover setup and usage. Licensed under AGPL-3.0: you can build on it, and if you distribute your changes or run them as a network service, you share their source under the same license. ## Contributing Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before you start. ## Learn with me Want to make money with AI? **[Raid+](https://www.skool.com/kenkai)**: land your first paying client in 90 days or your money back, plus private tools you won't find anywhere else. Want it built for you? **[work.kenkais.com](https://work.kenkais.com/)** ## Star history

If GG Coder is useful to you, ⭐ star the repo so more people find it.

因为别的 AI 编程 agent 实在让我火大。

English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español | Português | Deutsch | Français

本页为翻译版本，内容可能晚于英文版更新。如有出入，以 [English README](README.md) 为准。 GG Coder 是一款桌面编程 agent，让你已经付费的 AI 订阅发挥更大价值。 > ⭐ **如果 GG Coder 帮你省了时间或钱，请给它点个 Star。** 这是其他开发者发现它的主要方式。 ## 为什么选择 GG Coder - **同样的套餐，干更多活。** 在同一模型上与 20 个 agent 比拼，它最快、最省。完成同样的工作，Claude Code 多用了 169%。 - **真实代码，而不是瞎猜。** Agent Steroids 在你的电脑上搜索真实、最新的开源代码。不用受限速的 MCP 服务器，没有使用上限。 - **完成就意味着已验证。** Ken Autopilot 会一直推进工作，直到真正验证通过。 - **新手也能规范上线。** 写代码只是其中一部分。一键检查安全、合规、数据安全、无障碍、测试等，再加上项目健康评分（Project health），你不需要知道该问什么。 - **用你自己的订阅。** Claude、ChatGPT、Kimi Code、MiniMax、MiMo 套餐，任意 API 密钥或本地模型。 | Agent | 完成整套任务用时 | 每套任务用量 | 用时对比 GG Coder | 用量对比 GG Coder | | ------------------ | ---------------- | ------------ | ----------------- | ----------------- | | **GG Coder** | **102 s** | **$0.014** | | | | Codewhale | 112 s | $0.022 | 慢 10% | 多 58% | | Goose | 132 s | $0.020 | 慢 29% | 多 46% | | GitHub Copilot CLI | 136 s | $0.025 | 慢 33% | 多 83% | | Kimi Code | 138 s | $0.024 | 慢 36% | 多 74% | | Claude Code | 142 s | $0.037 | 慢 39% | 多 169% | | ForgeCode | 155 s | $0.042 | 慢 52% | 多 204% | | Dirac | 160 s | $0.029 | 慢 57% | 多 114% | | Crush | 165 s | $0.037 | 慢 62% | 多 173% | | Factory Droid | 167 s | $0.025 | 慢 64% | 多 83% | | Mistral Vibe | 169 s | $0.036 | 慢 66% | 多 164% | | DeepSeek-Reasonix | 170 s | $0.027 | 慢 67% | 多 99% | | Oh My Pi | 170 s | $0.031 | 慢 67% | 多 123% | | Xum | 172 s | $0.041 | 慢 69% | 多 203% | | Docker Agent | 173 s | $0.021 | 慢 70% | 多 51% | | Qwen Code | 177 s | $0.049 | 慢 74% | 多 257% | | Prime Agent | 190 s | $0.029 | 慢 86% | 多 111% | | Hermes Agent | 190 s | $0.027 | 慢 87% | 多 100% | | Deep Agents | 201 s | $0.041 | 慢 97% | 多 198% | | jcode | 380 s | $0.178 | 慢 274% | 多 1196% | 表格：2026 年 11 月 4 日的一次完整比拼。20 个 agent，均为当前稳定版（GG Coder v0.102.0），7 个任务，每个跑 5 次（共 700 次），全部使用 Claude Haiku 5.5 和相同的思考设置。每个 agent 拿到相同的提示词，每次运行都使用项目的全新副本，并以原始状态运行（GG Coder 也一样）：只用自带的内置提示词和工具，没有技能、插件、MCP 服务器或自定义指令。任务使用小型测试项目，外加一个关于 Vite 代码库（v8.3.5）的问题，因此没有 agent 是在处理自己的代码。只有隐藏测试通过或答案正确时，该次运行才算数。 ## 还包括 - **GG Goals：** 交出一个完整目标，由一组 worker 帮你完成。 - **Chat：** 能记住上下文的对话。 - **GG Motion：** 把你的想法变成视频。 ## 快速开始 1. 安装 GG Coder： **macOS（Apple Silicon）：** [下载最新版本](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest)，然后打开 `.dmg`。 **Windows：** [下载最新版本](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest)，然后运行 `.exe` 安装程序。 **Linux（x86_64）：** [下载最新版本](https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework/releases/latest)，然后安装 `.deb`（`sudo apt install ./GG*.deb`）或 `.rpm`（`sudo dnf install ./GG*.rpm`）。 **开发：** 安装好 Node.js、pnpm 和 [Tauri 前置依赖](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/) 后： ```bash git clone https://github.com/KenKaiii/gg-framework.git cd gg-framework pnpm install pnpm build pnpm --filter gg-app tauri dev ``` 2. 打开应用，连接你的 AI 服务商，然后选择 Code、Chat 或 Motion。 ## 基于框架开发 只想要引擎，不要桌面应用？在你自己的应用里使用同样的包，按需安装。 - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-ai**](packages/gg-ai/README.md): 连接 AI 服务商并流式获取响应。 - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-agent**](packages/gg-agent/README.md): 构建能使用你的工具、逐步完成任务的 agent。 - [**@kenkaiiii/gg-core**](packages/gg-core/README.md): 模型选择、身份验证和本地模型发现。 - [**@kenkaiiii/ggcoder**](packages/ggcoder/README.md): 应用和 CLI 背后的编程 agent、会话和工具。 构建你自己的 agent，从这里开始： ```bash npm install @kenkaiiii/gg-ai @kenkaiiii/gg-agent ``` 上面的包链接里有安装和使用说明。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可：你可以在此基础上开发；如果你分发修改后的版本，或将其作为网络服务运行，需要以相同许可证公开相应源代码。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提交 bug 报告、想法和 pull request。开始前请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和[行为准则](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)。 ## 跟我一起学 来我的 [Skool 社区](https://www.skool.com/kenkai)一起构建。获取帮助、分享你的作品，学习如何更好地利用 AI。 ## Star 历史

如果 GG Coder 对你有用，⭐ 点个 Star，让更多人发现它。
